Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 50
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator confused the Seattle neighborhood “Queen Anne” with “Queen Anne’s County, MD” and instructed WebSurfer to use the Maryland county site (qac.org). This geographic misdirection, along with later failure to enforce the constraints (single-family home and January 2023) when concluding with $445,000 from an unrelated condo sale, led to the incorrect final answer.
